# Reviews and choices

Follow `SKILL.md`; put the review's bottom line in the topic brief, without a
summary item. Keep routine checks in one item; a comment, risk or choice gets
its own item only if it needs an independent answer or discussion.

A review verdict is one `decision` ask; proposed comments are separate asks
when the owner needs to approve them individually. Put proposed text in
`outcome`, the PR/file in `links`, and follow the question shape in `SKILL.md`.
Post only with existing authorization or the owner's answer.

Compare 2–3 real alternatives in one question with their consequences; avoid
creating one child per alternative unless it needs independent tracking.
Merge, deploy, delete or spend asks are needed when existing authorization does
not cover the action, with the irreversible consequence explained.

## Example

An existing risk at revision 2 is ready for an owner choice. The recommendation,
no-answer default and affected work go in `note`; the `ask` stays one plain line.

```json
{"expected_item_revisions":{"1":2},"summary":"Prepared the retry review choice","operations":[{"op":"item.edit","item":{"id":"1"},"reason":"The review found one actionable retry risk","patch":{"question":"Should I request a retry-delay fix?","type":"decision","note":"What this means for you: one review choice can address the retry risk.\n\nI recommend requesting the fix (fairly sure) because clients retry together; if that's wrong, it delays a safe change. If you don't answer, I'll leave the review unposted.
```
